items.desc: BlackRock’s view supports the front end of the Treasury curve. Its caution on the long end, where it still sees yields rising as competition for capital intensifies, matches the heavy-supply theme flagged this week by Fitch and S&P. Neutral positioning on US equities, with a continued tilt to AI and tech, suggests BlackRock expects volatility around policy, not a broad selloff. A dovish-leaning Fed would also cap the dollar. Higher oil remains the main risk
